Write adduct hypotheses as CAMERA-style text

Source: R/AllGenerics.R, R/methods-numeric.R, R/methods-XcmsExperiment.R
formatAdducts.Rd

formatAdducts() writes the nBest most plausible hypotheses of each feature as text, best first, in CAMERA's format ("[M+H]+ 169.037 [M+Na]+ 146.048").

Usage

formatAdducts(object, ...)

# S4 method for class 'data.frame'
formatAdducts(object, nBest = 3, nFeatures = max(object$feature, 0L), ...)

# S4 method for class 'XcmsExperiment'
formatAdducts(object, nBest = 3, ...)

Arguments

object

A data.frame of hypotheses as returned by the numeric method of annotateAdducts(), or an annotated xcms::XcmsExperiment.

...

ignored.

nBest

numeric(1) number of hypotheses per feature; Inf for all.

nFeatures

integer(1), for the data.frame method only: the total number of features (length of the result).

Value

For the data.frame method a character vector with one entry per feature ("" without hypotheses). For the XcmsExperiment method the object with a rewritten adduct column; nothing is recomputed.

Examples

mz <- c(124.0392, 152.0342, 170.0445, 192.0275, 377.0300)
hints <- annotateAdducts(mz, AdductVoteParam(),
                         intensity = c(81, 50, 100, 11, 2),
                         groups = rep("FG.1", 5))
formatAdducts(hints, nBest = 1, nFeatures = 5)
#> [1] "[M+H-HCOOH]+ 169.037" "[M+H-H2O]+ 169.037"   "[M+H]+ 169.037"      
#> [4] "[M+Na]+ 169.037"      "[2M+K]+ 169.037"
